Full ACDE recap: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/all-core-devs-execution-acde-211-may-8/23835/4?u=timbeiko Here's a PR to move the Pectra Meta EIP to Final: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9740 It requires all the individual EIPs to also be moved.
